claims.statement: The repository is a monorepo: backend/ (Go API server, DDD/Clean Architecture), frontend/ (React 18 + Vite + TanStack Query + shadcn/ui, PWA), docs/ (evergreen reference material), openwiki/ (this generated wiki), plus plans/, scripts/, testplan/, qa/, Makefile, the dual docker-compose layouts, and the root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md.

Per-directory AGENTS.md files are the authoritative entry points for each area (AGENTS.md at root, docs/AGENTS.md, backend/AGENTS.md and backend/internal/*/AGENTS.md, frontend/AGENTS.md and frontend/src/*/AGENTS.md, backend/migrations/AGENTS.md).

The dev compose (docker-compose.dev.yml) runs MySQL + Redis + Adminer + 9Pay mock at :9001 + OnePay mock at :9002 with the backend outside Docker via air and the frontend via vite; the prod compose is the artifact that make deploy ships and is production-like with frontend (nginx) + backend + MySQL + Redis + nginx reverse proxy + on-demand adminer.

Makefile targets include make dev (backend + frontend in parallel), make api-test (integration suite), make api-lint, make api-build, make deploy, make restore, and make backup; backend/Makefile and frontend/Makefile carry the sub-area targets.

Production invariants are non-negotiable: x86_64/amd64 only, OnePay in production, clock.Now() (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh) for business time (ADR-006), zero framework imports in the domain layer (ADR-001), cache invalidation after commit (ADR-007), work on main directly (no worktrees), and commit format <type>(<scope>): <subject>.
